Method of Attack: Dependency repository hijacking (RepoJacking) where attackers register old usernames and repositories to serve malicious code
Malicious code injection via dependencies fetched from attacker-controlled repositories
Arbitrary code execution through npm install commands referencing hijacked repositories
Impacted Systems: Users executing npm install commands from compromised dependencies
Attack Vector: Hijacking of renamed or transferred GitHub repository names to serve malicious dependencies
Supply chain attacks via dependency resolution in package managers
